SELECT 
  step1.Name,
  step1.avg_ratio,
  step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg as difference
FROM (
  SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) as avg_ratio 
  FROM Track t 
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId 
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 
  GROUP BY mt.Name
) step1
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(step1_inner.avg_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) as avg_ratio 
    FROM Track t 
    JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId 
    WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 
    GROUP BY mt.Name
  ) step1_inner
) step2
WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg
